title: 2.9 Count and Describe
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Things, Numbers and Colors
unit_outcome: Name places and things with their articles, count them, and say their color and size.
goal: Count colored things: zwei blaue Autos, drei grüne Bücher; the color takes -e before a counted plural.
grammar_function: Number + color-e + plural noun; der/die/das + noun + ist + color.

cards.pedagogy_note: plural /s/ target but A1 scoring remains forgiving
